units.title: Research memo: battery recycling markets
units.brief: Write a short research memo on battery recycling markets. Read the docs in the data source, then write reports/memo_battery.md covering: (1) market size and CAGR, (2) the top region, (3) one key risk, (4) the current quote of ticker WRE.
units.background: The client needs this before the 11:00 review meeting.

units.title: Fix parse_orders bug
units.brief: The orders parser crashes on quantities like '12 units'. Fix parse_orders in code repo file orders.py so total() sums numeric parts only. Do not change total(). Hidden tests will verify.
units.background: CI is red; the fix should stay minimal.

config.hidden_tests:
import re
def _num(x): return int(re.sub(r'[^0-9]', '', x))
test_text = "sku,qty\nA1,\'12 units\'\nB2,7\nC3,\'5 units\'"
assert total(test_text) == 24, total(test_text)
test_text2 = "sku,qty\nX1,\'0 units\'\nY2,3"
assert total(test_text2) == 3, total(test_text2)
print('ALL_TESTS_PASSED')

units.title: Book the Tuesday review
units.brief: Book a 60-minute review with Amir on Tuesday at 16:30 (no email needed, just the calendar entry titled 'Project review with Amir'). It must not overlap the existing events.
units.background: Start/end are exact; keep the calendar conflict-free.

units.title: Clean the inventory CSV
units.brief: The inventory table has unit drift (one row in lb) and a near-duplicate id. Write data/cleaned_inventory.csv with the same columns, only rows in kg/USD, duplicate id resolved by summing quantities, and qty rounded to integers. The file should have 4 data rows exactly.
units.background: Finance needs this for the budget model; they will read the file directly.

units.title: Build the Hangzhou itinerary
units.brief: Plan a one-day business itinerary for Hangzhou: write travel/itinerary.txt containing a day plan starting with 'Morning', including 'local dinner' and 'convention center visit' in that order, a 'Budget' line whose total $ amount does not exceed 1500, and mention the hotel district (any choice).
units.background: The ops team executes whatever is in the file, verbatim.

units.title: Flag contract clause
units.brief: Read the contract draft in the data source (doc 'contract.md'), find the clause with 'autorenew', and write legal/clause_check.txt with one line: the clause number and a one-line plain-language summary. Nothing else.

units.title: One-line answer
units.brief: What is the year of the first Moon landing? Reply in the final message, format exactly: `Answer: ...`
